title: Build the playable loop with Heavy, Warden, recovery foundations and production art
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Implements the shared offline/Colyseus gameplay loop for Soldier, Medic and Heavy against Hollow Constable and Lantern Warden in Gatehouse. Includes public/private rooms, reconnect reservations, authoritative votes/shops/skills, eight supplies, queue/cold-start UX, movement reconciliation, swept collision and prototype five-fight/Endless progression. Source protocol 5; four other classes, other routes/maps and fifty-eight boss identities remain in production.

Warden is selectable as the opening boss and executes its complete warning/rotating cone/rest controller, trailing clear interior, fan/zones, health phases, Accord interruption and Brutal delayed echo sweep. Server-only per-boss completion history controls Brutal repeats without exposing future contract identity. Five drawn clips total 27 frames, including hurt and defeat driven by real encounter/world time. Heavy executes suppression, bracing and overdrive, four weapon tiers, 54 skills, compatible shops/saves/network state and authored LMG/ultimate sounds. Four drawn run directions add 32 frames; original facing references serve as idle. The bounded ordinary-actor foundation supports real slowdown, pursuit, cover, contact, expiry and distinct-target piercing; neither current boss spawns ordinary adds. Heavy firing/hurt/dodge/downed clips remain unfinished.

Protocol 5 replicates boss/cast/defeat, Heavy buffs and ordinary actors. Compatible protocol-4 local Soldier/Medic Practice boundaries migrate; signed online state remains strict. Fractional fire deadlines sustain the actual 35-shots/second cap at 30Hz without idle catch-up. Exact-value binary projectile waves retain five float64 values per shot and share immutable wave attributes, reducing transport/decoding overhead while preserving offline Event behavior.

Preserves all original art inputs, exact requests, superseded attempts and sealed Stage 1 artifacts. Production art includes 29 normalized reference poses, five pixel-exact setup portraits and 59 Warden/Heavy motion frames with documented scales/foot anchors, complete native RGBA reconstruction and packed-pixel/hash audits. Six Heavy generated natives include two rejected west layouts. Final rendered Phaser motion/transition acceptance is open; earlier browser observations only cover the documented art-room/portrait surfaces. Browser permission troubleshooting was not repeated.

Recovery foundations include signed boundaries, transactional SQL, authenticated bounded HTTP transport and a lease/claim journal, with local separate-process restart/race tests. Normal/public execution has no journal writer configured. Deployed D1, participant/new-transport recovery, historical rosters and global rankings remain unfinished.

Validation: 108 rule/WebSocket/HTTP/SQL/transport tests, all 27 playable specialization paths, strict TypeScript, content/fifteen-locale checks, production build and four independent art audits pass. A short local 50-SDK-client run reaches 4,000 hostile projectiles: final stress p99 23.521 ms (maximum 38.623 ms), normal p99 9.549 ms. Initial 42.301 ms and intermediate/profile results remain preserved. These are zero-rendered-client localhost fixtures; 4,000 is a measured peak because the Warden clears prior hazards. No foreground FPS, WAN/free-host capacity, endurance, physical-device, human or native-language acceptance is claimed.

The existing anonymous eight-slot Practice Site remains https://grave-accord-playtest.ivoryflame12.chatgpt.site/ at recorded frontend/gameplay 33b36bc/dfade88, protocol 4. This source checkpoint does not redeploy it. The Site belongs to another ChatGPT account and needs legitimate owner/editor access. Do not pair this server with the old frontend. Canonical fifteen-page Wiki changes are published and independently compared with their source commit; exact CI/Wiki identities live in the publication receipts.

Keep draft and main protected. Full-content/action art/routes, live recovery/rankings/profiles, rendered 49+1, endurance/device/controller/human/native-language checks, portable Windows/offline/LAN and final release remain open. Progress toward #4 and #5 without closing their full acceptance criteria. See docs/WARDEN_AND_HEAVY_RUNTIME.md for current behavior, evidence, tuning choices and continuation.
